    Profile

    Edwin is a soldier who guards the borders of Lustburg. He's a talented swordsman, and is somehow able to laugh his way out of any situation, no matter how tough. Privately, he mocks his country's female-dominated society, which he thinks foolish. If the bribe's big enough or the client interesting enough, he's been known to let some pretty shady individuals across the border.

    Origin: Lustburg
    Gender: Male
    Height: 189cm
    Weight: 77kg
    Birthday: Dec 26
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Nightmare Cherry Blossom
    Likes: Transparency
    Hobbies: Reading
    Illust: ─
    CV: 中西尚也
